findings.message: Retain the corrected mouth emergence and trident contact, but place the great sword at Mahiṣāsura's neck in a clear, non-graphic beheading stroke.
Place Devī's pinning contact unambiguously on the buffalo's neck rather than the crown of its head.
Restore only the page-authorized rejoicing gods in the high distance; do not restore the lion or foreground troops.
Reduce the bright red neck band and trident blood so the decisive action remains family-appropriate and non-graphic.
Move crown, halo, trident and cloud detail below y=0.24 within x=0.08..0.92.
